Class FlowUtils

public with sharing class FlowUtils

Utility class that provides invocable methods for Salesforce Flows to execute various operations. Supports dynamic method execution via JSON parameters including password generation, UUID generation, report URL retrieval, invoice numbering, settings access, and Stripe transaction synchronization. Designed for Flow callouts with flexible method routing.

@InvocableMethod(category='BlazeBite' description='Utility methods used in flows' label='Flow Utils' callout=true)
public static List<String> executeMethod(List<String> methodRequest)

Executes a specified method from Salesforce Flows based on JSON input parameters. Routes to various utility operations including password/UUID generation, report URLs, invoice numbers, settings retrieval, and Stripe synchronization. Method name and parameters are passed as JSON key-value pairs.

Parameters:
    methodRequest – JSON string array containing method name and parameters as key-value pairs

Returns:
    String[]: Array containing the response from the executed method
